capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Mercedes-Benz USA release: "85 (usable)" kWh on both CLA 250+ and CLA 350 4MATIC.

chemistry.notes: Mercedes-Benz USA release names Nickel Manganese Cobalt (NMC).

nominal_voltage_class.notes: mbusa: 800-volt electric architecture (a factory 400 V converter from Spring 2026).

preconditioning.notes: Release: heat pump and navigation bring the high-voltage battery to the ideal temperature before DC fast charging. No manual control is mentioned (not proven absent).

ac_max_kw.notes: mbusa data sheet: AC 9.6 kW (8.75 h 10-100 % on the 2027 sheet).

published_10_80_min.notes: mbusa data sheet: 22 min (assumes a 500 A charger).
